name: CoopMarketingFundClaims
tagline: Never lose co-op money again: accruals, pre-approvals, proof of performance and reimbursements in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete dealer co-op / MDF fund app for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages dealer portals. Track the fund the OEM accrues, plan activities against the available balance, request pre-approval, submit claims with media-specific proof of performance inside the claim window, follow review, approval and payment, and act on the use-it-or-lose-it balance before the fund expires.
features: Fund balance waterfall and expiry warning
Allowed status transitions with required fields
Calendar of starts, ends and deadlines
Accrual ledger by dealer and program
Demo mode with fictional dealer data
